description: Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS with System76's COSMIC desktop. Built by a hardware company for creators and gamers: first-class NVIDIA support, tiling window management out of the box, and an opinionated, keyboard-driven workflow.

maintainer.note: Catalog-only entry: the install plugin is not written yet. Note: Pop!_OS does not support Secure Boot; it must be disabled. ISO URL and SHA-256 come from the official build API (api.pop-os.org).
